scripts.api:schema: uv run --locked --directory backend python -m taskbot.entrypoints.api.export_schema openapi.json && yarn workspace frontend run api:generate
scripts.verify: yarn check:size && yarn check:scripts && yarn verify:backend && yarn api:check && yarn verify:frontend
scripts.verify:backend: uv lock --check --directory backend && uv run --locked --directory backend ruff check . && uv run --locked --directory backend ruff format --check . && uv run --locked --directory backend mypy && uv run --locked --directory backend lint-imports && uv run --locked --directory backend pytest -m "not integration" && uv run --locked --directory backend pytest -m integration
scripts.test:unit: uv run --locked --directory backend pytest -m "not integration" && yarn workspace frontend test
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --locked --directory backend alembic upgrade head
